key.name: click-preset
key.summary: Preset a click on the tile switches to
key.description: Clicking the tile switches to this preset; clicking it again while it is active goes back to the default-preset (Studio Monitors (LP-6) when that is empty). Empty = clicking opens the preset menu.

key.name: default-preset
key.description: The extension switches to this preset once per session, after eq-default.service has applied Studio Monitors (LP-6). It is also the home preset: the top bar shows an icon only while another preset is active. Empty = keep the preset of eq-default.service.
